## Counts (endorsed rows)
- Headline claims: 73.
- Joint claims: 5 (C9, C34, C40, C75, C76).
- Claims in at least one relation: 31 (42.5%).
- Clashes: 0.

## Joint claims
- C9 staff positive, energy sustained: Q interviews (F1); N survey (F8, F9); confirm.
- C34 adult workers the main engine: N Table 5 (F35); Q case studies (F36, F37); confirm.
- C40 adult workers linked to reduced care: N days in care, Table 5 (F34, F35); Q case studies (F37); expand.
- C75 access to adult workers, workload, team stability: Q open-ended (F13; F16 from F17); N office survey (F18); expand.
- C76 conditions swift, practice change slow: N skill-time correlation (F28); Q MI interviews (F4, F50), supervision observations (F38); expand.

## Points to check
1. F19: if read as fieldwork (Q), C10 becomes joint again (C75 is joint anyway).
2. C34 fit: confirm or expand (case studies add the mechanism).
3. C40: F34 may be a premise, not support; F34 is not significant (p=0.06).
4. R9 "It seems clear that" accepted as a marker (rule 10).
5. Case-study selection from the Table 5 hypothesis (p.43-44) and coded observations are design-level notes (rules 9, 13), not transformations.
